_maintained_by: Hand-authored. The Go (bindings/go/rules.go) and TypeScript (bindings/typescript/validate.ts) rules both read this file, so every vector must hold in both, message for message. Each document is raw JSON text handed to ValidateRules / validatePaymentRequestJSON unchanged. wantErrKind is '' (admitted), 'direct_deposit' (a DirectDepositRuleError naming wantRule), 'unsupported' (the EIP-3009 destination rule, which runs first) or 'ambiguous' (a case twin in a member the rules read). validateErrKind is 'schema' where Validate's schema pass refuses the document before the rules run (Go only: the TypeScript binding has no schema pass); otherwise Validate answers as ValidateRules does.
_rule: An originator-executed deposit (executor.deposit is originator) is funded by the payer with directDeposit before the request exists, so the request must name everything the deposit committed: deposit_nonce, quote_selector (the reserver) and fulfillment_verifier.account (the releaser) as nonzero addresses, a positive max_source_amount, a request_id the depositRequestHash v2 reader accepts, a nonzero ERC-20 source on an EVM chain held by an EVM source.account, and exactly one destination whose composed form fits the escrow's 256 bytes. It carries no sender_auth, and reserve is the settler's. Any other request carries no deposit_nonce. The rule names other than source and destination match payment-gw's direct deposit admission (CORE-3050, CORE-3051).
